## Build Update

Committed a bounded hygiene repair at `833ab4d52c33cd2fb02fae57367797935e5d865a`: removed the accidentally versioned `faktorial-result-2c405d547f98f9ef14fc35e7abf2149b.json` worker artifact. The resulting source tree exactly matches the requested verification target `868fbb25c776eddddc8c5cec91bc64658a839210`; the Makefile, `make.cmd`, Pages workflow, README, application behavior, and deployment semantics are unchanged.

Retained quality log `fk1-1789336740089067520` shows that repository verification did not start: the published checkout lacked `.faktorial/main-verify.json`, and the verifier reported dedicated quality-evidence repair task `fk2` ready. That configuration failure is therefore not attributable to this task's permitted source surfaces. `git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD` passed, and `git diff 868fbb2..HEAD` is empty. Per repair-stage rules, no tests, typechecks, or canonical quality command were run locally.

pull_request_description.delivered_outcome: Removed an accidentally committed Faktorial worker-result artifact so the branch again contains exactly the intended build-pipeline contribution and no agent runtime output.
pull_request_description.implementation_approach: Deleted only the tracked `faktorial-result-2c405d547f98f9ef14fc35e7abf2149b.json` byproduct. The resulting tree is identical to requested verification target `868fbb25c776eddddc8c5cec91bc64658a839210`; no Make adapter, workflow, documentation, application, or deployment files changed in this repair.
pull_request_description.solution_rationale: Worker-result envelopes are orchestration byproducts and must not be versioned. Removing the leaked file restores the precise source tree that Faktorial was instructed to verify without expanding into the separately owned published-quality-configuration failure.
pull_request_description.tradeoffs_and_alternatives: No attempt was made to add or guess `.faktorial/main-verify.json`: retained verification explicitly assigned that missing published configuration to dedicated repair task `fk2`, and changing it here would exceed the permitted Makefile, `make.cmd`, Pages workflow, and README repair boundary.
pull_request_description.architectural_decisions: No architectural or process changes were made.

The retained canonical run did not execute repository commands because published quality configuration was unavailable; it reported repair task `fk2` ready. No tests, typechecks, or canonical quality commands were run in this repair session, as required. A fresh Faktorial-owned `run-quality` gate is requested for the committed head.
